summary: 2026-27 home kit. TATNEFT on the front and WINLINE on the sleeve and shorts, per the KHL's official 2026/27 kit render in the league's marketing blog (13 Sep 2026; the article warns rendered sponsor logos may differ from the final kit). The club site's own sponsor data names Tatneft as general sponsor and Tatneft AZS Center and TANECO as official sponsors, with Olimp.bet among partners; none of these are tied to a readable jersey placement. The back, shoulder patches and helmet are not verified, so the list is not complete.
